method.cold: First invocation of each model; only first case starts a fresh native process. Android trial 2 reuses the native process; all models are released between cases.
method.comparison: Preparsed Rank programs, in-memory binary weights, complete MLP and materialized results; CPU f64 versus GPU f32 accepted at atol=rtol=1e-5.
method.control: Unprofiled GPU calls follow the interleaved samples; order/JIT effects prevent attributing differences solely to profiling.
method.memory: Desktop RSS high-water marks include libraries, CPU reference and harness. Android excludes the separate WebView renderer. Reported VmHWM decreased between snapshots; these are observed values, not a reliable lifetime peak.
